# Agentic SEO Skill

Curated by Skill Harbor: a deterministic, LLM-first SEO audit framework for coding agents. Sixteen named sub-skills cover the full checklist (full audit, single page, technical SEO, content quality and E-E-A-T, schema, sitemap, images, GEO for AI search, AEO for answer engines, hreflang, programmatic SEO, competitors, links, and GitHub repository SEO), and ten specialist agents adopt roles like technical SEO, content quality, performance, and a global verifier that deduplicates findings and suppresses contradictions before anything is written. The signature move is evidence over vibes: 89 bundled Python scripts fetch and parse pages, check robots.txt, Core Web Vitals through the free PageSpeed API, security headers, broken links, redirects, readability, and llms.txt readiness, and every finding must carry evidence, impact, and a concrete fix with an explicit confidence label (confirmed, likely, or hypothesis). Full audits ship a FULL-AUDIT-REPORT.md plus a prioritized ACTION-PLAN.md, and a scoring rubric with published weights keeps results comparable across runs. By @Bhanunamikaze, listed here with credit to its creator. Positioned against ultimate-seo-geo (also in this batch, which presents itself as a Claude-focused SEO and GEO audit with scoring): this one targets several agent platforms (Antigravity, Codex, Claude) and leans on script-verified evidence and confidence labels rather than a headline score.
